entities.name: Jeanne Hébuterne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jeanne Hébuterne was a French painter and art model best known as the frequent subject and common-law wife of the artist Amedeo Modigliani. She died by suicide two days after Modigliani's death, and is now buried beside him.
